title: Precision Neuroscience inks partnership with venture fund backed by spinal cord injury advocates
summary: Precision Neuroscience’s brain-computer interface—a wireless device that aims to restore function to people with paralysis—is getting a boost from SCI Ventures. The fund is backed by the Christopher & Dana Reeve Foundation and other major spinal cord injury organizations.

title: Meross’ radar presence sensor ditches the cord and adds Matter-over-Thread support
summary: Meross has announced a new version of its MS600 presence sensor that’s now battery-powered, so installation isn’t limited to places where you can camouflage a power cord.  A single CR123A battery powers the new MS605 presence sensor for up to three years.
